featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增默认关闭、可手动开关的用户可见 Task 自动拆分策略；启用后按单一结果边界创建，Git Task 固定使用独立 Worktree。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add an opt-in user-visible Task splitting policy that defaults off; when enabled, each result gets its own Task and Git Tasks always use isolated Worktrees.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Harness 当前版本镜像与已发布变更记录不同步的问题，并增加发布版本一致性门禁。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix drift between the current Harness version mirrors and materialized change records, with a release-version consistency gate.
